Name: Alchemist's Alchemist's Adventure Lunchboxes
Author: BTypeAlchemist
Description:
🔧 Update & Fixes (ver.2.0.0)

This update resolves issues from version 1.0.0 and introduces new content.

- Fixed incorrect recipe ingredient bugs from the previous version.
- Added a brand-new hidden recipe.
- The hidden recipe unlocks automatically after cooking all 20 lunchboxes.
- IMPORTANT: Please fully delete version 1.0.0 before installing this update to avoid conflicts.



A prepared traveler is a surviving traveler.
This mod adds [b]20 alchemy-inspired lunchboxes[/b] created by a wandering alchemist.
Each meal is carefully prepared using mystical ingredients, herbs, and enchanted cooking techniques to keep adventurers energized during long journeys.
Whether you're exploring the mines, wandering through forests, or preparing for a dangerous dungeon expedition, these compact alchemical meals provide nourishment for any traveling farmer.
Each lunchbox has its own unique name, description, and energy value, forming a collection of experimental alchemist cuisine.
Not all alchemy is about potions — sometimes it’s about the perfect lunch.
[b]
[/b][b]Features[/b]
• Adds [b]20 alchemist themed lunchbox meals[/b]
• Fully edible cooking items
• Unique names and descriptions
• Designed as [b]portable adventure meals[/b]
• Content Patcher compatible
• The recipe can be purchased at Gus's Saloon.

[b]Requirements[/b]
SMAPI
Content Patcher

[b]Compatibility[/b]
Compatible with most Stardew Valley mods.
Should work alongside other cooking expansions.

Created by [b]BTypeAlchemist[/b]
